newsitem.title: USA: Enron wind unit gets Minnesota contract.
newsitem.headline: Enron wind unit gets Minnesota contract.

text.p: Enron Renewable Energy Corp said Zond Development Corp, an Enron Wind Corp subsidiary, was selected by Northern States Power Co to supply 100 megawatts of wind generated electricity in Minnesota.
The 100-megawatt project is the third phase of a 400 megawatt renewables program in which Northen States will purchase power under a 30-year agreement with Zond, the Enron Corp unit said.

This project award marks the third 100 megawatt project which will utilize Zond's Z-750 kW Series wind turbine generators, the largest wind turbines manufactured in the United States. Zond is currently constructing Northern States' 107 megawatt Phase II wind generation project, which consists of 143 Zond Z-750 kW wind turbines.
